# Kazan Delicacies (pepperoni.tatar)

> Manufacturer of halal sausage products and Tatar bakery in Kazan, Russia (Kazan Delicacies LLC). The pepperoni.tatar catalog is the full range, not a single pepperoni line. Wholesale supply for retail chains, HoReCa, fuel stations and distributors; private-label / contract manufacturing. Halal DUM RT No. 0008 (meat, poultry, sausages, pepperoni, semi-finished; 2 Oct 2026–1 Oct 2029), No. 614A/2024 (meat; 17 Feb 2024–16 Feb 2027), No. 884A/2025 (bakery and ready meals; 27 Dec 2025–26 Dec 2026), additional registry numbers 976A/2026 and 1002/2026 (product scope is not published as text), HACCP, ISO 22000:2018 (FSMS-2351/A), Made in Russia No. SS.003181 (until 23 Oct 2028), TR CU 021/2011. Catalog: 65 SKUs in 3 sections, updated 2026-10-11.

Key terms (owner-approved):
- Prices EXW Kazan, with and without VAT; wholesale volumes are calculated per pallet. Minimum order: 1 pallet.
- Current export shipments: Kazakhstan, Belarus, Kyrgyzstan. Uzbekistan and Azerbaijan are Cerberus attestation, available for supply.
- Private label (contract manufacturing): from 5 tonnes. Stages and lead times per contract. Production capacity — 12 tonnes per shift.
- Shipping documents: halal certificate, declaration of conformity, veterinary certificate (Mercury), Chestny Znak marking, electronic waybill.
- Delivery, lead times and samples are agreed individually. Every product is certified to the Halal standard. No alcohol is used.

Contacts: +7 987 217-02-02 · info@kazandelikates.tatar · 2 Agrarnaya St., office 7, Kazan 420061, Russia.

- [Halal ham, wholesale](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/vetchina-optom): chicken and turkey ham.
- [Price list](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/price): HTML, Excel and PDF from the same catalog as the cards.
- [How to order](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/kak-zakazat): steps, pallet minimum, EXW Kazan, shipping documents.
- [Halal pepperoni wholesale (money hub)](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/pepperoni): formats, prices, export.
- [Jerky and snack sausages, private label](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/jerky): beef, poultry, lamb, horse; flowpack.
- [Hot-dog sausages](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/sosiski-dlya-hotdog): fuel-station and street-food line, pallet basis, enquiry form.
- [Kazylyk](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/kazylyk): horse-meat sausage, gift box and sliced.
- [Private label / contract manufacturing](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/private-label): from 5 tonnes, documents, stages.
- [Cases and buyers](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/cases): fuel-station chains, retail, foodservice, private label.
- [Export](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/export): countries and certificate-recognition status.
- [Export to Kazakhstan](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/export/kazakhstan): current shipments, Cerberus, no invented transit days.
- [Halal to Uzbekistan](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/export/uzbekistan): Cerberus attestation, available for supply, no UZS offer.
- [Sausage in dough for bakeries](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/sosiska-v-teste): KD-018 casing-free and KD-061 ready roll.
- [Halal bakery](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/vyipechka-halyal): Tatar line KD-046–052, 065, 066.
- [Pepperoni for pizzerias](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/pepperoni-dlya-pizzerii): KD-013/014 application, no invented oven test.
- [Retail chains](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/dlya-setey): KD-025–034, 036–045 matrix, catalog EAN.
- [Distributors](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/dlya-distributorov): 65 SKUs, EXW, pallet, exclusivity individually.
- [HoReCa](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/dlya-horeca): grill and chilled sausages; ham and patties as links.
- [Bakery for coffee shops](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/zamorozhennaya-vypechka-dlya-kofeen): freezer scenario, no invented oven programme.
- [Chak-chak wholesale](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/chak-chak-optom): KD-053 plastic and KD-054 kraft 300 g, shelf life and price from the catalog.
- [Bakery for bakeries and coffee shops](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/halyal-vypechka-optom-dlya-pekaren): frozen pastry and sausage in dough; order via /en/kak-zakazat.

## Certificates (SKU matrix)

- 0008: meat, poultry, sausages, pepperoni, semi-finished products, culinary, cuts (categories BI, BIII); GOST R 70401-2022; 43 SKUs; valid until 2029-10-01; check: https://pepperoni.tatar/docs/certificate-halal-0008-2026.pdf
- 614A/2024: meat products; 43 SKUs; valid until 2027-02-16; check: https://halalrt.ru/certificates/company/119/kazanskiye-delikatesy/
- 884A/2025: confectionery, bakery and ready meals; 22 SKUs; valid until 2026-12-26; check: https://halalrt.ru/c/4hDESSiMNsDK3Jt/
- 976A/2026: product scope is not published as text on the public registry card; scope not published; valid until 2027-06-03; check: https://halalrt.ru/c/7eK53w8SXP8M7zC
- 1002/2026: product scope is not published as text on the public registry card; scope not published; valid until 2027-02-16; check: https://halalrt.ru/c/67CpLps2FMkeJ6d
- ISO 22000:2018 (not a halal certificate): food safety management system (HACCP); 65 SKUs; valid until —; check: https://www.iafcertsearch.org/certification/Y10VN21OAQGYY0PBRaTGYfPx
- СС.003181: Russian Export Center Made in Russia programme; 65 SKUs; valid until 2028-10-23; check: https://pepperoni.tatar/docs/made-in-russia-cc003181.pdf

Document check: [https://pepperoni.tatar/en/halal](https://pepperoni.tatar/en/halal). ISO 22000 is not a halal certificate.
